parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter will be removed in the future.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the data synchronization instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

*   **Forward**
*   **Reverse**

> 
*   Default value: **Forward**.
*   This parameter is required only when the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

parameters.name: SynchronizationJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the DescribeSynchronizationJobs operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: SynchronizationObjects
parameters.description: The objects that you want to synchronize. The value is a JSON string and can contain regular expressions. For more information, see [SynchronizationObjects](~~141901~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts modify-synchronization-object --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-id dtskfq1149w2540000 --synchronization-objects DBName_:_dtstestdata --synchronization-direction Forward --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts ModifySynchronizationObject --region cn-hangzhou --SynchronizationJobId dtskfq1149w2540000 --SynchronizationObjects 'DBName_:_dtstestdata' --AccountId 123233440000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SynchronizationDirection Forward
